message:
Blog post slugs now keep the base letter of accented characters: "Crème brûlée recipes" becomes `creme-brulee-recipes`. `npm test` passes (3/3), including the previously failing `test/blog-slug.test.js` case.

The change is one line in `src/blog/slug.js`. It decomposes the title to NFD and strips the combining marks before calling the vendored `slugify`. I didn't touch `vendor/`.

The same bug exists in `src/shop/product-url.js`, which calls the vendored `slugify` directly, so product URLs still drop accents. I left it alone since you asked for the blog fix only. If you want it, the same normalization can go there, or in a shared helper.

I didn't commit anything.
